title: Academy Museum Gala: Taylor Swift, Sabrina Carpenter, Jennifer Hudson, More Stars Walk the Carpet
summary: Anna Kendrick, Adrien Brody, Mark Hamill, Kate Hudson, Seth Rogen, Pamela Anderson, Brittany Snow, Naomi Ackie, Charlize Theron, Mia Goth, Cailee Spaeny, John Leguizamo, Mckenna Grace, Zoey Deutch, Kristen Wiig and A$AP Rocky were also in attendance at the star-studded event.
